metadata.title: मिस इंडिया फ़ाइनल में पहुँचने वाली आदिवासी लड़की | Riya Tirkey: Dark skin girls in Modling
metadata.description: Riya Tirkey has become the first tribal girl in the country to reach the Miss India finale. she says that her journey has just begin and she is looking forward to many more beauty pageants. Apart from modeling, Riya also wants to work in films. In this conversation, she told us how boys and girls of tribal community can make a name and money in the world of fashion and films.
